{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01F191JQ6SZVyx24LW9i2cM3","type":"tool_result","content":"---\n./cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp\n./cahn-hilliard/CMakeLists.txt\n./common/hash.hpp\n./common/results_output.hpp\n./output.txt\n---\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int rc = runBenchmark(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\nproject(cahn_hilliard_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Target GPU generations (Volta through Hopper); override with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 75 80 86 90)\nendif()\n\nfind_package(MPI REQUIRED)\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\n# The solver is a single hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA translation unit, so it is compiled by nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(cahn_hilliard.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(cahn_hilliard cahn_hilliard.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1ufkzP32gNTWW2jLv8H","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cahn-Hilliard benchmark now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It is still the `cahn_hilliard` executable, and only `cahn_hilliard.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` changed. The output matches the original bit-for-bit under the source's strict arithmetic (details below), and it is 57× faster than the original at 256³ on 4 GPUs.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** the grid is split into z-slabs, one rank per GPU. Each step does two halo exchanges (c, then μ) and staged host buffers are used, so CUDA-aware MPI is not required.\n- **CUDA:** each rank keeps its slab on the GPU and runs the chemical-potential and update kernels. Interior planes overlap the halo exchange on a second stream.\n- **OpenMP:** initialization, the NaN/range validation, and per-rank thread sizing. The FNV hash and Kahan sum stay sequential, since they must be exact.\n- **Build:** CMake compiles the `.cpp` as CUDA and links MPI, OpenMP, and cudart. The `-O3 -march=native` flags carry over, and the minimum CMake version is now 3.24.\n\n**Results**\n- 108 runs (9 grid shapes × 1–8 ranks × 2 repeats, including `nz` < ranks, single-plane slabs, and 0 steps) all match the reference results block exactly.\n- 256³ × 50 steps: original 5028 ms; hybrid 311 ms on 1 GPU and 88 ms on 4 GPUs.\n\n**Judgment calls**\n- **FMA contraction is off on host and device.** The original built with `-march=native` fuses multiply-adds, so its default hash (`945edb7f…`) differs from the source-exact hash (`d49bfc3f…`) that the new code reproduces. The difference is about 1e-15 relative. If you need the default-built hash, the GPU kernels would need explicit `fma` calls matching GCC's choices. That is possible, but it makes the code harder to read.\n- **No CPU fallback.** The program aborts if no CUDA device is visible, as the spec requires.\n- **Grid dimensions must be positive.** A zero-size grid now returns an error instead of running with empty arrays.\n- **Architectures:** the default targets sm_70 through sm_90. Override with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n\n**Bug found and fixed during testing**\nThe initial field was uploaded with a legacy-stream `cudaMemcpy` from pageable memory. That call can return before the DMA finishes, so some ranks exchanged stale halos at step 0. Under GPU sharing (e.g. 8 ranks on 4 GPUs) most runs were wrong. The upload is now stream-ordered, and the stress matrix passes.\n\n**Not covered**\n- Only one node with 4 GPUs was available, so multi-node behavior is untested.\n- Overlap gains are small at these grid sizes because halo messages are tiny.\n\nScratch builds and test scripts are in `/tmp`, not in the project."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2062,"cache_read_input_tokens":159784,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2062},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cb48803f-d827-482f-a971-f93e36e56477","uuid":"1c554b40-01db-4603-b2dd-72841e77fd5f","timestamp":"2026-10-14T09:40:40.978Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1ufkenfr47FVauXmjrM"}
